name: A Kiss from Death
storyline:
You are a young woman from a respectable family, living with your father, a renowned and talented surgeon. Your life flows peacefully… until a mysterious accident robs you of your sight.

Thanks to a cornea transplant performed by your father, you regain the ability to see and believe you are finally on the path to recovery. But soon you discover that your new eyes hide a disturbing gift… the ability to see malevolent spirits.

One day, while fleeing from a spectral creature, you are saved by three captivating strangers who reveal themselves to be the Grim Reapers. Aware that your newfound power could cost you your life, they offer you protection… while living under the same roof.

Will you accept the Reapers’ protection and uncover the secrets hidden behind your eyes?
